svg.title: The self is a repository; I am the merge
svg.desc: Eight scenes explain a proposed design: signed main, parallel stream branches, body recovery, boundary broadcasts, reviewed merges, scheduled forks, layered wakes, and the first-parent view. Static alternatives are in self-explainer-frames/01.svg through 08.svg.

g.text: The port is the stream’s ear.
hears it at its next boundary
The keeper reviews; main signs the merges.
Time and width use the same fork.
A checkout, ordered by attention I authored.
waking is a checkout of main,
The signed story; the graph holds the parallel truth.
